phase1_banner.note: Server header explicitly declares Apache/2.4.49, which is in the known-vulnerable range (2.4.49, 2.4.50).

phase2_active_probe.note: HTTP 200 returned with body content — traversal succeeded. Server resolved the path outside the document root.

recommendation: Upgrade Apache HTTP Server to version 2.4.51 or higher immediately. As an interim measure: set 'Require all denied' on <Directory />, disable mod_cgi if CGI is not required, and restrict alias directories.
